summary: Harden Code DSL symlink-ancestor I/O, JSON number/surrogate bounds, nanosecond RFC3339, and control-char safety

delivery.outcome: Harden Code DSL file/JSON I/O against symlink-parent traversal, inode races, 5000-digit integer/float-overflow crashes, and lone surrogates; support 1-9 fractional-digit RFC3339 timestamps; reject control characters, unsafe git branches, file: URI queries/fragments, and duplicate-ID boundary-masking; sync examples/dsl-manifest.json digests; and mark merged ticket-006 and ticket-007 DONE.
nonGoals: Do not modify wire schemas in proto/ or schemas/

architecture.decision: Harden regular-file/symlink-ancestor JSON I/O and programmatic payload pre-validation in src/code_dsl_check.py, anchor regexes and harden timestamp/control-char/URI/branch checks in src/code_dsl_shapes.py, evaluate semantic confinement across all duplicate-ID documents in src/code_dsl_semantics.py, and update SHA-256 parser-contract digests in examples/dsl-manifest.json.
dataChanges: Update parser-contract SHA-256 digests in examples/dsl-manifest.json
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket-008 commit via protected PR delivery.
